tasks.label: SaveState: Host on this PC (Linux / WSL)
SaveState: Show host logs (Windows)
args: $d = if (Test-Path "$HOME\.nexus-windows-host.json") { (Get-Content "$HOME\.nexus-windows-host.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).dataDir } else { "$HOME\.nexus-data" }; Get-ChildItem "$d\logs" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "==== $($_.Name)"; Get-Content $_.FullName -Tail 20 }
